messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: prometheus_scrape_proxy_throttle for job=prometheus/scrape-proxy in prod (pager: pd-inc-7821). Auto-page to eng-sre rotation :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Alert details -> https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-7821 -- symptoms: scrape proxy HTTP 429s, high request latency to exporters, backlog in log-ingest-kafka.
chen li: acked the page — taking lead. pulling initial context, will post findings.
mira: seeing surge of 429s on scrape-proxy pods since ~t-8m. errors look like ``429 rate limit exceeded: client_id=prometheus-puller``. exporter request queues long.
alex r: checking kafka consumer lag for log-ingest topic: consumer-group=log-shipper-prod has +120k lag across partitions, retention ok but throughput stalled. probable upstream throttling from scrape-proxy.
chen li: quick mitigation idea: scale scrape-proxy replicas x2, temporarily disable per-client rate-limits to drain backlog. will coordinate with ops-lead before removing limits.
mira: confirming the exporter endpoints still respond but with 429s and occasional 502. sample cURL to an affected exporter: ```curl -sS -D - http://10.32.45.12:9100/metrics | head -n 20``` returns repeated 429s and Connection: keep-alive headers.
chen li: running scale now: ```kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy scrape-proxy --replicas=8``` (was 4 -> 8). posting rollout status...
incident-bot: Deploy scrape-proxy scaled: rollout started for deployment/scrape-proxy (replicas=8).
mira: after scale, 429 rate drops on two pods, but still spikes on a subset of exporters — looks like a slow exporter tail causing sticky connections.
alex r: beginning consumer rebalance for log-shipper to reassign partitions more evenly: ``kafka-consumer-reassign --group log-shipper-prod --rebalance``. will monitor lag.
chen li: temporarily bumped scrape interval for large tenants to 60s -> 120s to reduce QPS while we stabilize: ```sed -n '1,120p' /etc/prometheus/scrape.targets | sed 's/15s/60s/g'``` then applied.
oncall-next: chime-in — what's customer impact? ops-lead asked for clear scope for customer comms.
mira: earliest check: missing scrape metrics for two high-traffic tenants (tenant-slug: big-shop, tenant-id: 1122) across dashboards; alerts for app-health triggered for those tenants. downstream dashboards show 20-30m gaps in recent series.
ops-lead: prioritize: customer-facing monitoring degradation for big-shop. we should open a support ticket and notify customer success if gaps persist >30m.
chen li: current status: scale applied, rate-limit removed for prometheus-puller client, consumer rebalance started. backlog drain rate ~12k msgs/min, expected clear in ~25min at current throughput.
log-ingest-bot: INFO: consumer lag decreased from 122k to 88k in 7m. Estimated time-to-zero ~18m at current rate.
mira: also restarted a misbehaving exporter pod (node-10) which had high FD count. that removed a noisy tail that was causing repeated reconnects.
alex r: Kafka lag now 65k, partition distribution balanced. I'm watching for underflow or rebalance storms.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-7821: acknowledged by chen li. Escalation policy paused while oncall handles.
chen li: preparing handoff plan in 20m or earlier if backlog cleared. oncall-next @oncall-next, please prepare to monitor the consumer and scrape-proxy metrics. also follow up to revert temporary config changes once stable.
oncall-next: will monitor. if lag stops decreasing for next 10m, escalate to ops-lead.
ops-lead: noted. please capture exact commands and timeline for postmortem. assign owners for follow-ups: - root cause analysis: alex r; - exporter hardening: mira; - runbook update for scrape-proxy limits: chen li.
chen li: creating ticket: SRE-4683 with notes and runbook changes. attaching logs and commands used.
mira: early RCA hypothesis: sudden increase in scrape concurrency combined with per-client rate-limits and a handful of slow exporters caused head-of-line blocking at scrape-proxy. Kubernetes autoscaling too conservative for burst.
alex r: follow-up infra changes I propose: add HPA-based scaling for scrape-proxy based on request latency, add per-exporter watchdog and backoff, and add consumer parallelism increase for log-shipper.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: incident status -> Mitigated (backlog draining, major customer metrics returning). next update in 30m or when resolved fully.
chen li: marking this thread resolved for immediate paging. will keep monitoring and update ticket when backlog reaches zero. thanks team :thumbsup:
ops-lead: please run a customer-impact scan and prepare CS note template if big-shop gaps exceed 30m.
log-ingest-bot: final check at t+50m: lag=2k, backlog mostly drained.
chen li: closing PD incident (PD-7821) now. ETA for full normalization 10m. handoff to oncall-next for watch.
oncall-next: ack — watching metrics for next 1h.
ops-lead: great work. file postmortem checklist, include timeline, commands, and who paged/acked, and schedule a 1hr blameless review tomorrow.
chen li: will draft postmortem and link to ticket SRE-4683.
incident-bot: Incident closed.
